# `aitbc genesis verify`

Verify the genesis block and configuration for a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc genesis verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to verify (auto-detected from config if not provided) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc genesis verify
```
